name: Busa Writer
description: Channel-ready content drafting and review desk

agentPrompts.label: Turn a source into a review-ready content batch
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-writer` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then take the source I give you — blog post, transcript, outline, or announcement — and produce a fresh batch of channel drafts in Busabase, then give me the AirApp URL to review them.

agentPrompts.label: What needs review across all drafts?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-writer` skill in this folder, then summarize the drafts still needing review or approval, grouped by channel, and flag anything blocked or missing proof from the source.

agentPrompts.label: Export the approved drafts into a publish-ready pack
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-writer` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run `export_decisions.mjs --apply` to package every `approved` draft into a channel-ready Markdown+ZIP pack and mark each one `done`. Never export a draft without an explicit approval, and never re-export one already `done`.
